state.goal: Choose accessible GCC Arabic-English functional transcription app design based on supplied textual observations, not direct pixels.

concepts.1: Ivory forest green editorial headings; clear readable stacked Arabic and English panels. Broadcast controls separate. No imagery. Calm admin reading.
concepts.2: Midnight navy high contrast cream large original/translation pairs; amber status. Projector dark layout.
concepts.3: White cobalt oversized transcript typography. Controls right. High accessibility, but large panels consume space.
concepts.4: Sandstone burgundy serif editorial cultural styling, readable spacious panels; less neutral.
concepts.5: Sage charcoal compact navigation; parallel two transcript columns causes narrow reading on phone; generated fake mosque location must be discarded.

state.requirements: Root LTR; Arabic text RTL; no fake live microphone states/statistics; no speed certainty. Phones need stacked paired passages; projectors need large high contrast type.

questions.question: Best default reading/admin design for warm neutral GCC app?
Should generated fake venue location and microphone-on demo states be excluded from implementation?
